summary: RBAC-02 Project Ancestry Enforcement: implemented verifyProjectAncestry adapter and requireProjectAncestry middleware. Enforces strict workspace-to-project hierarchy and verifies that entity resources (boards, columns, cards, comments, images, uploads, imports) belong strictly to the requested project and workspace. Probing sibling resources or guessing IDs across projects returns 404 NOT_FOUND with zero metadata leakage. Audited and certified by independent reviewer with score 9.745/10.0.
api_contract: docs/API.md v0.3 and docs/FEATURE_SPEC.md (Section 2: People, projects and permissions)
limitations: Application queries and middleware enforce ancestry; PostgreSQL RLS remains an optional defense-in-depth layer.
